class: clear-before-assign ordering on a shared pending slot

steps: src/panel/panel.js:620 assigns the IIFE result after it already cleared the slot
src/panel/panel.js:601 loops while the slot is set

fix: Run the get inside a .then so it is always async, and signal waiters from the newest read instead of looping on a promise slot.
impact: The panel frame hangs; no report, no fallback.
mechanism: The async IIFE catches the throw and clears pendingDefaultRead before returning; the outer assignment then stores the settled promise, which nothing clears, so `while (pendingDefaultRead) await pendingDefaultRead` spins on microtasks and timers never run.
title: A settings.get that throws synchronously freezes the panel
trigger: 1. Open the panel on a host whose orca.settings.get throws instead of returning a rejected promise.

steps: src/panel/panel.js:625 only the newest read clears the slot

fix: Waiters resolved by the newest read.
impact: The panel stays on 7d until the first read times out (up to 120 s).
mechanism: await pendingDefaultRead awaits the captured promise, not the newest.
title: firstLoad waits on the read it captured, so a stuck first read blocks a newer answer
trigger: 1. First read stalls. 2. Default range changes; the newer read answers. 3. firstLoad is still awaiting the first.

class: proxy state used for user intent

steps: src/panel/panel.js:605 moves the range when not picked
src/panel/panel.js:836 Custom click opens the fields without marking a pick

fix: Set rangePicked on any range-button click, Custom included.
impact: Custom fields stay open under a 30d selection.
mechanism: Opening Custom does not set rangePicked, so firstLoad moves the range and leaves #custom-range visible.
sweep: Range clicks and Apply set rangePicked; the Custom open path did not.
title: The default moves the range while the Custom date fields are open
trigger: 1. Setting read is slow. 2. Click Custom (fields open, rangePicked stays false). 3. The setting answers 30d.
